blocks.content: Recall the code we wrote on the previous page:

items: A lazy component suspends while its chunk downloads.
React walks up the tree looking for the nearest Suspense boundary.
It renders the fallback until the chunk is ready.
Once loaded, it swaps in the real component.

blocks.content: Now let's see how lazy() and Suspense look together in a full route setup.
